description: Curated data-center industry news (DC Hub) from 40+ trade sources (DCD, Data Center Knowledge, Data Center Frontier, Capacity Media, etc.), refreshed every 30 min. Filter by category (deals/permits/outages/policy/AI), source, or date range. Keyless calls return a preview.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies)

source.description: Restrict to one trade source, e.g. DCD, "Data Center Frontier"

name: dchub_get_news
